QuestInfo.name: [Lion King's Castle] Key to the First Tower
QuestInfo.0: #p2161003# promised to stay behind to help others even after his brother was rescued. In order to go to the tower, you must have the #t4032832# that #b#p2161003##k carries.
QuestInfo.1: #p2161003# knows how to make the key, but he's asked you to bring the materials. Defeat #r#o8210000##k and find enough of the #b#t4000625##k items to make the key.
QuestInfo.2: #p2161003# made you the #t4032832#. Use it to unlock the Roof of the First Tower, and face #o8840002#.

0.0: Do you need the #t4032832#? I can make it for you. It's nothing, really. I examined the lock while I was looking for my brother.
0.1: I need the materials to make the key, though. I used up everything I had experimenting with the locks. You can get the stuff I need from #r#o8210000#s#k. That'll be easy for you, yeah?

yes.0: Wonderful! You bring me #b50#k of the #b#t4000625##k items, and I'll whip that key right up for you. I already have the key mold and everything.

no.0: Oh? Are you afraid of #o8210000#s, too? No way! How did you even get this far? Are you a master of Play Dead, too?

1.0: Looks like... Yep! Those are all the #t4000625#s I requested. You sure are something. Let's get you that key, huh?

yes.0: Here's your #t4032832#. I'll make you another one if you lose it. I might make another anyway. Nothing else to do around here...

item.0: Don't have those #b50 #t4000625##k items yet? Hey, I'm not saying anything. It's not like I could defeat #r#o8210000##k.
